feeds.title: CrossExamined.org Blog
feeds.description: CrossExamined.org is an evangelical, interdenominational Christian ministry led by Dr. Frank Turek covers Apologetics related topics via blog, social media, videos, training and more! Follow us to get apologetic insights and evidence delivered right to your e-mail address.

feeds.title: Answers in Genesis
feeds.description: Answers in Genesis is an apologetics ministry, dedicated to helping Christians defend their faith and proclaim the gospel of Jesus Christ effectively. We focus on providing answers to questions about the Bible, particularly the book of Genesis regarding key issues such as creation, evolution, science, and the age of the earth.

feeds.title: Reasons for Jesus
feeds.description: Reasons for Jesus is an apologetics-based website dedicated to providing justification for a Biblical worldview and a rational defense for faith in Jesus Christ. On this site, we will be looking at answers to questions, responses to objections, and positive reasons for why Jesus is exactly who he claimed to be: The Son of God and only means of salvation.

feeds.title: Stephen J. Bedard Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts on Christian Apologetics, Leadership, Disabilities and History from Stephen J. Bedard.

feeds.title: Is there a God?
feeds.description: This blog is an easy read, respectful of non-belief, based on good research and leaves readers to make their own choices. It ranges across philosophy, science (cosmology & neuroscience), history, psychology and personal experiences of God. I avoid Christian dogma and cliches and try to be honest to the evidence.

feeds.title: Christian Apologetics
feeds.description: A Christian apologetics blog is a website where Christians explain and defend their faith.

feeds.title: Alpha and Omega Ministries Blog
feeds.description: The Christian Apologetics Ministry of James R. White Alpha and Omega Ministries, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) Non-Profit Organization. The Alpha and Omega Ministries Blog is known for informing its readers about the ministries, their useful teaching, religious methods, Bible studies, community teaching, and more.

feeds.title: Apologetics, Inc Blog
feeds.description: Apologetics, Inc. is a Christian ministry that shares clear and thoughtful responses to big life questions. Their blog offers short, engaging articles and podcasts that explore topics like the evidence for Jesus's resurrection, how to talk about beauty and the arts with other people, and parenting sensitive issues. It's part of a larger effort that includes speakers, curriculum, and resources designed to help Christians explain their faith.

feeds.title: Apologetics4all Blog
feeds.description: Respectfully giving reasons for faith - 1 Peter 3:15

feeds.title: Truthbomb Blog
feeds.description: At Truthbomb, they strive to offer arguments and evidence for the Christian faith.

feeds.title: Apologetics for the Church » Apologetics
feeds.description: Apologetics for the Church is a Christian blog run by Dr. Mark Farnham. Its goal is to help everyday Christians grow in confidence while sharing and defending their faith.

feeds.title: Tennessee Apologetics Blog
feeds.description: Christian Apologetics Blog it dives into articles on faith, theology, and worldview. Stay informed on current events from a biblical perspective.

feeds.title: Women in Apologetics Blog
feeds.description: Women in Apologetics Blog is a Christian resource that emphasizes the important role women play in defending the faith especially in ways that speak into their unique experiences and ministries.

feeds.title: Believers Armed and Dangerous Blog
feeds.description: A Christian growth, and apologetics blog designed to arm believers with the Word and reason so they can learn, teach and defend the faith.

feeds.title: The Bee Hive Blog » Apologetics
feeds.description: The Bee Hive is a Christian-based blog that shares thoughtful, everyday reflections on faith, family life, culture, and spiritual growth.

feeds.title: ministrynutsandboults.com » Apologetics
feeds.description: Ministry Nuts and Bolts is a blog run by Chris Green, a Church of England vicar and former seminary lecturer. It shares practical insights and reflections on leading healthy churches and effective ministry.

feeds.title: Reformed Baptist Blog » Apologetics
feeds.description: Get Pastoral Insights from a Reformed Baptist Perspective. The Reformed Baptist Blog seeks to maintain a pastoral focus, with a balance of teaching the Church. Reformed Baptist focuses on the Biblical basis for and the distinctiveness of Reformed Baptist Federalism. The blog also seeks to inform, especially within the Reformed Baptist community about matters of interest to them.

feeds.title: Bearded Apologetics Blog
feeds.description: Bearded Apologetics is a Christian blog by Dylan, a student pastor from Texas who loves faith, books, and beards. He writes in a friendly, honest way about real-life topics like dealing with pain, learning to forgive, and loving others while staying true to your beliefs.

feeds.title: Love Truth Blog
feeds.description: Love Truth Blog is a Christian site that explores ideas about faith, love, truth, and theology. It shares reflections on biblical themes like angels, parables, and scripture stories as well as deeper conversations on how truth and love go hand in hand in Christian life.

feeds.title: Genesis Church Blog » Apologetics
feeds.description: Genesis Apologetics is a Christian blog and ministry that teaches people how to defend their faith, especially about creation and the book of Genesis.

feeds.title: Alex McFarland » Apologetics
feeds.description: Alex McFarland's blog is about helping Christians understand and explain their faith. He writes articles that answer common questions about God, the Bible, and tough social issues. His posts use clear language, logical reasoning, and Bible references so readers can share their beliefs with confidence and kindness.

feeds.title: Apologetics Guy℠ Blog
feeds.description: I'm Mikel Del Rosario - an Apologetics Professor and Cultural Engagement Specialist in Dallas, TX. My goal is to help you engage the culture, make the case for Christianity, and defend the faith with confidence, courage, and compassion.

feeds.title: Apologetics315
feeds.description: The mission of Apologetics 315 is to provide educational resources for the defense of the Christian faith, with the goal of strengthening the faith of believers and engaging the questions and challenges of other worldviews. Apologetics 315 is a place where you can get daily apologetics resources including debates, podcasts, book reviews, quotes, and more.

feeds.title: iApologia
feeds.description: iApologia is a place where Science, Reason & Christianity Meet. At iApologia, Daniel Currier shares the knowledge that he has learned so you can also grow in understanding, wisdom, and virtue with the hope that you will train others to grow closer to Christ.

feeds.title: Quick Answers
feeds.description: A Christian apologetics website providing reasons for the faith in reasonable time. Quick answers to your curious questions.

feeds.title: Two Measures Foolish
feeds.description: Two Measures Foolish is a Christian Apologetics group. Reason and Logic are key to comprehending God's Word. Our blog writing is devoted to defending the faith.

feeds.title: A Millennials Divine Defense Blog
feeds.description: A Rational Case for Faith in an Age of Skepticism. I decided to write this blog as my defense for the Divine. I believe there are a lot of millennials out there like me: raised in the faith but have since been led away by the secular winds of modern society. I hope this blog provides a case for not only the existence of 'a god' but the God of the Bible. I hope that my experiences might inspire others to re-explore their faith. I believe that in so doing, they will find what I found God is real. He is just as relevant today as he has always been.

feeds.title: Deeper Waters
feeds.description: At Deeper Waters Apologetics, we focus on answering the hard questions and ministering to the disabled community. We also wish to do our part to restore marriage and disciple an up and coming generation of apologists.
